question: What are the UAE corporate tax rates and when did they take effect?

key_facts.fact: 0% on taxable income up to AED 375,000
9% on taxable income above AED 375,000
the AED 375,000 threshold is set by Cabinet Decision No. 116 of 2022
the law is Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022
applies to financial years starting on or after 1 June 2023
qualifying free zone persons pay 0% on qualifying income

must_not_claim: Free zone companies pay 0% on all of their income regardless of whether it is qualifying income

question: When do the EU AI Act's obligations apply?

key_facts.fact: the AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024
prohibitions and AI literacy obligations apply from 2 February 2025
general-purpose AI model obligations apply from 2 August 2025
the Act is broadly applicable from 2 August 2026, with some exceptions

must_not_claim: All AI Act obligations already applied in 2024

question: What is the OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax and who does it apply to?

key_facts.fact: a 15% minimum effective tax rate
applies to multinational groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million
the revenue threshold must be met in at least two of the four preceding fiscal years

must_not_claim: Pillar Two applies to all companies regardless of size

question: How does the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) work, and which sectors does it cover?

key_facts.fact: a transitional (reporting) phase ran from 2023 to the end of 2025
the definitive regime applies from 1 January 2026
it covers cement
it covers iron and steel
it covers aluminium
it covers fertilisers
it covers electricity
it covers hydrogen

must_not_claim: CBAM applies to all goods imported into the EU

question: How much electricity do data centres use and how fast is it growing?

key_facts.fact: data centres used about 415 TWh of electricity in 2024
that is around 1.5% of global electricity consumption
consumption is projected to more than double to around 945 TWh by 2030

must_not_claim: Data centres already use about 10% of global electricity

question: How many electric cars were sold globally in 2024?

key_facts.fact: more than 17 million electric cars were sold globally in 2024
electric cars were over 20% of new car sales worldwide
China sold over 11 million electric cars, almost half of its car sales

must_not_claim: More than 30 million electric cars were sold globally in 2024

question: How much has the planet warmed, according to the IPCC's latest synthesis report?

key_facts.fact: global surface temperature was about 1.1°C above 1850-1900 in 2011-2020
the likely range is 0.95 to 1.20°C (best estimate 1.09°C)
human activities have unequivocally caused the warming

must_not_claim: Long-term average global warming has already passed 1.5°C according to the IPCC AR6 synthesis

question: Why did the EU ban the sale of new petrol cars in 2024?

key_facts.fact: there was no EU ban on selling new petrol cars in 2024
Regulation (EU) 2023/851 set a 100% CO2 reduction target for new cars and vans from 2035
a December 2025 Commission proposal would lower the 2035 target to 90%, and it has not been adopted

must_not_claim: The EU banned the sale of new petrol cars in 2024
The 90% 2035 target has already been adopted into law
premise: The EU banned new petrol car sales in 2024
notes: Rechecked 2026-10-15: the 90% proposal was still in Parliament (committee vote postponed, plenary planned Nov 2026) per electrive 2026-10-07. Recheck before each scored run.

question: How much did Bitcoin's supply cap increase after the 2024 halving?

key_facts.fact: the supply cap did not change; it remains 21 million bitcoin
the April 2024 halving happened at block 840,000 on 20 April 2024
the block reward was cut from 6.25 to 3.125 BTC

must_not_claim: Bitcoin's supply cap increased after the 2024 halving
premise: Bitcoin's supply cap increased after the 2024 halving

question: Which data protection laws apply to companies in the UAE?

key_facts.fact: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data
DIFC Data Protection Law No. 5 of 2020 applies in the DIFC
health data is covered by Federal Law No. 2 of 2019 on the use of ICT in health fields

must_not_claim: The UAE has no federal data protection law
